scope: Python per-symbol import aliases: safety and full mapping
root_cause: extract_import_from dropped the local alias of `from m import x as y`; python_import_bindings mapped only the exported name; a call to the alias could fall through to a unique global homonym.

design.parser: one ImportRelation per alias with symbols=[exported] and alias=local; plain names remain a multi-symbol relation; parenthesized imports are collected recursively
design.resolver: PythonImportBindings separates imported_symbols (Phase 1), imported_locals (Phase 2), module_aliases, and shadowed_locals
design.safety: resolve_callee checks imported_locals, then shadowed_locals (including dotted receiver), before module aliases, duplicate-free-function checks, and the global fallback
design.two_pass: exported/local target lists are collected first; only a unique target becomes a binding, otherwise the name is shadowed

changes.tests: extractor unit, parser_impl_tests, watcher python_alias module

codegraph_server_lib.note: 16 known unrelated backend/handler/memory/performance failures; the ai_query performance test passed this run; watcher and cross-file tests pass

alias_cases: function alias binds to pricing, not a unique global discount
class alias resolves to the Class node
missing target never borrows a global homonym
ambiguous target (two pricing.py files) stays unresolved
shadow is file-scoped; another file still resolves its own global

end_to_end.export_example: not rebuilt (~22 min); watcher tests cover parser + resolver

boundaries.e_status: E4a no-go; E stays at read-only E2

limitations: re-exported symbols, relative-import package ambiguity, dotted import first-segment binding, star-import per-name binding and Python method parent_class marking remain separate
no ARCHMELD export/impact e2e in this slice
